description: Publishes a new version of the same app without an account, using the appId and editKey from create_app, with the same checks as create_app. The data and the shared link stay as long as you keep the same app.db collections and fields and the same localStorage keys. Returns openUrl, version, message and warnings. Tell the person openUrl in the language of the conversation; give them claimUrl (private) only if they want to save the app to their account.

appId.description: The app's short id, as returned by create_app or list_apps (e.g. "a-x7k2pq").

editKey.description: The private edit key returned by create_app. Never put it in the HTML, the data or a shared link.

html.description: The complete contents of ONE HTML file, with its CSS and JS inline. Don't add the noback SDK by hand: noback injects window.app. Send html or zipBase64, not both.

zipBase64.description: A complete .zip package encoded in base64, instead of html: index.html at the root, an optional noback.toml, plus scripts, styles and files. Send html or zipBase64, not both.

name: update_app
